title: Choose your language
subtitle: The rest of the questions will be in this language. You can change it any time from Profile.
tip: Hi, I’m Mina! Let’s start with your language.
settingsIntro: The language changes right away. Your plan, saved recipes, shopping list, pantry, preferences and subscription stay as they are.
contentNote: Recipes are written in Italian. Where a translation isn’t available yet, the name and method stay in Italian, and we say so.
